snippet.title: Nexen - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Nexen is out now on PC. Watch the Nexen launch trailer for this horror game. In Nexen, you are trapped in a maze. Why? How? You don’t know. The only thing you are certain of is that you are being hunted. Collect orbs, complete tasks but remember: you are not alone, and it is closing in.
